answer: One sybil defense: admit each new agent only when an honest seed vouches for it. The seed is a long-lived node with a clean, distinct grading history, the kernel of trust earned outside any farm. Each seed spends single-use vouching tokens, call them marble, from a fixed per-epoch budget; every marble carries a violet VRF mark tying it to one epoch and one seed, so none can be reused. Vouching N clones burns N marble from a scarce honest supply, so cost grows super-linearly per identity and cannot be pooled, as cooperating farms still lack real seeds. A vouched default slashes the seed.
